description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the KpiDao class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It tests methods such as saveKpi, getKpiById, getKpiList, getKpiCount, deleteKpi, and default KPI handling, verifying data retrieval, persistence, deletion, and default status functions related to KPI entities.

classes.name: KpiDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class for testing the KpiDao's data access methods in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the KpiDao instance and loads test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI entity and verifies the saved data equals the original.

methods.name: testGetKpiById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of KPI by ID, including a null result for non-existent ID.

methods.name: testGetKpiList
methods.description: Checks that KPI list retrieval returns expected number of entries, filtered by job title when specified.

methods.name: testGetKpiCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of KPI entries with and without filters.

methods.name: testDeleteKpi
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple KPI entries and verifies deletion count.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Ensures unsetting all default KPIs resets their default status.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpiWithId
methods.description: Tests unsetting default KPI while specifying a particular KPI ID, verifying status remains when required.

methods.name: testGetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the current default KPI.
